CoreWeave stock-based compensation revenue percent 2026 quarter results

findings.claim: 年度稀釋加權股數：2023 約403.7M、2024 404.4M、2025 436.0M（+7.8% YoY）；AlphaQuery 獨立列示 FY2025 為436.00M
findings.source: AlphaQuery / tickerleague 彙整（weighted average shares outstanding diluted）
findings.excerpt: CoreWeave diluted shares outstanding in 2024 was 404.41M, edged up 0.2% from 2023. and 2025's annual diluted shares outstanding for CoreWeave (CRWV) came in at 436.00M – grew 7.8% year-over-year.

findings.claim: 聚合站Digrin列示SBC約每季$144M–$165M（2025Q3至2026Q2）；2025全年SBC約$630M，2024為$31.49M（聚合站數字，未對照10-K）
findings.source: Digrin CRWV Financials；tickerleague SBC expense（第三方彙整）

findings.claim: 2026年基本股數快照分歧（Equibles：419.0M、428.2M、447.6M，日期未標；Substack 2026-01稱約497M；tickerleague稱最新稀釋527M但與+7.8%標示不一致），無法定出2026年增率；需以Q2 2026 10-Q核實
findings.source: Equibles CRWV；Substack「CoreWeave's Projected Shareholder Dilution in 2026」；tickerleague

findings.claim: TIKR稱CoreWeave併購Core Scientific（$9B全股票）完成時將顯著稀釋既有股東；是否已完成未查證
findings.source: TIKR blog：CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) stock tanks over 10% as investors are worried about narrowing margins

findings.claim: 2026Q2營收約$2.575B（+112% YoY），營業損益$(49)M；搜尋未取得2026 SBC佔營收比的官方數字，SBC/營收比需由判斷層以上述SBC與營收自算

note: 股數與SBC皆為第三方聚合站，as_of為期間末日而非發布日；無官方10-Q逐字原文，未用WebFetch。多數finding無法逐字摘錄故excerpt=null。
